Sr. Information Security Analyst
Location: Anaheim, California (Hybrid)
 

Role Overview
The Senior Information Security Analyst serves as a subject matter expert supporting Identity Governance and Administration (IGA) and Identity and Access Management (IAM). The primary focus of this role involves identity governance, privileged access, identity security, and the tools and integrations that support the identity environment of the organization. This position requires collaboration with cross-functional technical and business stakeholders to ensure robust security controls.
 

Key Responsibilities
Support and administer Identity Governance and Administration (IGA) and Identity and Access Management (IAM) technologies.Manage identity governance platforms, integrations, identity security, and privileged access.Support Privileged Access Management (PAM), password vaulting, Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA), and identity-related security controls.Establish and maintain role-based access controls (RBAC) and separation of duties.Support identity lifecycle changes including new hires, terminations, transfers, and role or title changes.Configure, deploy, monitor, and troubleshoot enterprise security technologies.Partner cross-functionally with technical and business stakeholders to provide technical guidance.Cross-train across additional information security domains to provide backup support when needed.

Required Qualifications
Education: A bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience is required.
 

Experience: Four to six plus years of information technology experience with a strong focus on information security and identity management.
 

Technical Skills: Hands-on experience with IAM, IGA, identity security, or privileged access management. Knowledge of privileged accounts, PAM, MFA, password vaulting, role-based access, and separation of duties is required.
 

Preferred Qualifications
